Security policy

Source: SECURITY.md

Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately by email to the maintainer, Jimmy Moses, at jimmy.moses@pnguot.ac.pg, not in a public issue on GitLab.

Include the tidydiversity version, R version, and a minimal example that shows the problem. You should receive a reply within two weeks.

Supported versions

Only the latest development version on the main branch receives fixes.
